5° guteza imbere serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga za
Leta hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga mu
miyoborere hitabazwa ikoranabuhanga mu
itumanaho no mu mikoranire n’ubuyobozi,
mu rwego rw’ibigo bya Leta, ibishamikiye
kuri Leta n’iby’abikorera;
6° gukora ku buryo ibikorwa
by’ikoranabuhanga bibera mu gihugu bigira
imikorere myiza yubahiriza amategeko
mpuzamahanga;
7° kureshya abashoramari no guhanga ibishya
mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga mu
itumanaho mu rwego rwo guteza imbere
ibikorwa by’ikoranabuhanga;
8° guteza imbere imikorere itanga umutekano,
iboneye kandi inogeye umufatabuguzi,
ubucuruzi na Leta ku bijyanye
n’imyitwarire n’imigendekere y’ibikorwa
by’ikoranabuhanga;
9° guteza imbere ibikorwa by’ikoranabuhanga
bitanga igisubizo ku byo abafatabuguzi
n’abakiriya bakeneye;
10° guteza imbere ubukungu n’imibereho myiza
binyujijwe mu iterambere rishingiye ku
itangazabumenyi koranabuhanga;
11° koroshya uburyo bwo kubika inyandiko mu
mikoranire n’ibigo bya Leta n’ibindi
biyishamikiyeho;
12° guteza imbere itangwa rya serivisi nziza mu
buyobozi binyujijwe mu ibikanyandiko
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga;
13° korohereza ihuzwa ry’amabwiriza mu buryo
bwo kwemeza no kurinda ubusugire
bw’inyandiko zibitswe hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’Urwego ngenzuramikorere ku byerekeye iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi Urwego ngenzuramikorere mu byerekeranye
articles.text:
n’iyoherezwa ry’amakuru koranabuhanga ndetse
n’imiyoborere hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga rufite
inshingano zikurikira :
1° gushyiraho ibisabwa mu kwita ku mutekano
w’inyandiko koranabuhanga binyujijwe mu
mabwiriza,
2° gutuma habaho uburyo bw’icuruzwa
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga budafite
imbogamizi zituma habaho gushidikanya
mu bisabwa byo kwandika no gushyira
umukono ku nyandiko,
3° gushyiraho uburyo bwiza bwo gukora
hifashishijwe itangwa rya serivisi
z’ibyemezo koranabuhanga, kugira ngo
inyandiko koranabuhanga n’uburyo
zihererekanywa bikorwe ku buryo bwizewe
na buri wese, kandi habeho guteza imbere
ubucuruzi koranabuhanga hifashishijwe
umukono koranabuhanga utuma itumanaho
koranabuhanga rihabwa icyizere cy’uko
ubutumwa bukiri umwimerere;
4° guteza imbere ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga
mu miyoborere no mu itangwa rya serivisi
zindi hashyirwaho ibisabwa n’imirongo
ngenderwaho mu mikoreshereze
y’imiyoboro;
5° gushyiraho uburyo bunoze mu micungire
n’imikorere myiza y’ihererekanya
ry’ubutumwa bwa interineti mu gihugu;
6° gushyiraho amabwiriza agena imicungire
y’ibisigazwa by’ibikoresho
by’ikoranabuhanga.
7° gukora ibindi bikorwa byatuma ibisabwa
n’iri tegeko byubahirizwa.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’Urwego ngenzuramikorere mu bijyanye n’imicungire y’izina ndangarubuga Urwego ngenzuramikorere rufite inshingano
articles.text:
zikurikira:
1° kugena imiyoborere n’imicungire
y’umwanya w’izina ndangarubuga “.rw”;
2° gukora ku buryo habaho iyubahirizwa
ry’imikorere myiza mu rwego
mpuzamahanga mu miyoborere y’izina
ndangarubuga ".rw";
3° gushyiraho ibisabwa abiyandikisha
n’ababandika, uburyo bukoreshwa mu
kwiyandikisha, ibishobora gutuma
wangirwa cyangwa uhagarikwa gukora
n’uburyo bwo kugarurirwa izina
ndangarubuga;
4° gushyiraho amabwiriza ashingirwaho mu
kugena ibiciro;
5° kugena ingingo z’ibanze z’amasezerano
yerekeye izina ndangarubuga agomba
kwemezwa hagati y’abandika
n’abiyandikisha;
6° gushyiraho uburyo bwo kwirinda
akarengane n’imikorere ibangamira ipigana;
7° kugena uburyo bwo gushyiraho imbuga
nshya zishamikiye munsi y’urubuga rwa
interineti hashingiwe kuri politiki iriho
irebwa n’amabwiriza yerekeranye na
gahunda y’igihugu yo guha nomero aderesi
koranabuhanga;
8° gushyiraho uburyo bwo gukurikirana no
kugenzura iyubahirizwa ry’iri tegeko n’andi
mabwiriza, by’umwihariko urubuga rwa
interineti rufite izina ndangarubuga “.rw”;
9° guha Ministiri ibitekerezo kuri politiki
ijyanye n’imikoreshereze y’izina
ndangarubuga “.rw”;
10° kugenzura ibindi byose bijyanye
n’umwanya w’izina ndangarubuga “.rw”
kugira ngo iri tegeko ryubahirizwe.
Icyiciro cya 2: Inyandiko n’umukono
koranabuhanga

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iki cyiciro Ingingo z’iki cyiciro zirebana n’inyandiko n’umukono koranabuhanga bijyanye n’ubutumwa
articles.text:
buhererekanyijwe cyangwa buhererekanyijwe ku
buryo bwikoze hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Inyandiko zitemerezwa umwimerere Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe rigena urutonde rw’inyandiko zidashobora kwemerezwa
articles.text:
umwimerere hakoreshejwe umukono
koranabuhanga cyangwa guhererekanywa ku buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’amakuru n’ubutumwa koranabuhanga mu rwego rw’amategeko Inyandiko ntiteshwa agaciro mu rwego
articles.text:
rw’amategeko kubera ko igice cyayo cyangwa yose
ikozwe mu buryo koranabuhanga.
Amakuru yinjijwe mu masezerano ariko
atagaragarira buri wese afatwa nk’ayinjijwe mu
butumwa koranabuhanga igihe ayo makuru:
1° afitanye isano n’amasezerano ku buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose umuntu yaba yabonye
aho yakomotse inkomoko yayo
ikongerwamo,
2° aboneka mu buryo ashobora gusomwa,
kubikwa cyangwa gushakishwa n’undi
muntu akoresheje ikoranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa kubahirizwa mu nyandiko koranabuhanga Iyo itegeko risaba ko amakuru aba mu nyandiko,
articles.text:
ibisabwa biba byubahirijwe n’inyandiko
koranabuhanga igihe amakuru akubiyemo ashobora
kugerwaho kugira ngo akoreshwe igihe cyose
akenewe.
Iyo itegeko risaba ko inyandiko ishyirwaho kashe,
ibisabwa biba byubahirijwe iyo inyandiko ifite
umukono koranabuhanga w’umuntu ubifitiye
ububasha.
Igihe hari itegeko ryemerera umuntu kohereza
inyandiko cyangwa amakuru bikandikwa cyangwa
bikemezwa n’iposita cyangwa serivisi zikora nka
yo, ibisabwa biba byubahirijwe igihe kopi
y’inyandiko cyangwa amakuru koranabuhanga
byohererejwe utanga serivisi wemewe n’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere, ikandikwa n’ubuyobozi butanga
icyemezo kandi akaba ari na rwo rwohereza iyo
nyandiko kuri aderesi koranabuhanga yatanzwe na
nyir’ubwite.

articles.heading: Ibikwa ry’inyandiko cyangwa amakuru koranabuhanga Igihe cyose bisabwa n’itegeko, kubika inyandiko
articles.text:
koranabuhanga cyangwa amakuru mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bikorwa hubahirijwe ibi
bikurikira:
1° amakuru abikwa ku buryo ashobora kugerwaho
kugira ngo byoroshye ikoreshwa ryayo;
2° inyandiko koranabuhanga ibikwa mu buryo
bw’umwimerere ikimeze nk’uko yakozwe,
yoherejwe, yakiriwe, ibikubiyemo bitahindutse;
3° aho amakuru yaturutse, uwo yohererejwe, itariki
n’igihe yoherejwe cyangwa yakiriwe.
Haseguriwe amategeko ajyanye n’ibikwa
ry’inyandiko cyangwa amakuru mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, urwego rubifitiye ububasha
rushobora kugena ibisabwa by’inyongera mu kubika
inyandiko koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Ibikwa ry’inyandiko y’umwimerere Igihe bisabwa n’itegeko ko amakuru atangwa cyangwa abikwa mu mwimerere wayo, ibyo
articles.text:
byubahirizwa hakoreshejwe inyandiko
koranabuhanga iyo:
1º umuntu yakwizera ko inyandiko ikimeze
nk’uko yateguwe ku buryo budasubirwaho
nk’inyandiko koranabuhanga cyangwa
n’indi iyo ari yo yose;
2º inyandiko ishobora kwerekanwa igihe cyose
isabwe.

articles.heading: Isuzuma ry’uburyo bwizewe bwo kwita ku makuru Isuzuma ry’uburyo bwizewe bwo kwita ku makuru
articles.text:
rireba niba:
1° amakuru yarabitswe yuzuye kandi
ntacyayahindutseho, usibye inyongera yo
kuyemeza cyangwa kuyashyigikira
n’ihinduka ryaterwa n’itumanaho risanzwe,
imibikire n’imurikwa;
2° ibipimo ngenderwaho by’isuzuma ry’ayo
makuru cyangwa inyandiko bishyirwaho
hitawe ku cyo ayo makuru yari agamije
ndetse bitewe n’imiterere y’igihe yakorewe.

articles.heading: Kohereza inyandiko cyangwa amakuru Igihe bisabwa n’itegeko kohereza inyandiko cyangwa amakuru, ibisabwa byubahirizwa iyo
articles.text:
1° hitawe ku bintu byose bigaragaza ko mu
gihe ubutumwa bwoherezwaga, uburyo
koranabuhanga bwakoreshejwe mu
kohereza inyandiko bwizewe ku buryo
butuma inyandiko cyangwa amakuru
agumana umwimerere wayo;
2° igihe ubwo butumwa bwoherezwaga,
amakuru abukubiyemo yashoboraga
kugerwaho kugira ngo akoreshwe ibyo yari
agenewe.

articles.heading: Nyir’inyandiko koranabuhanga Inyandiko koranabuhanga iba ari iy’umuntu igihe ari we wayikoze
articles.text:
Inyandiko koranabuhanga ifatwa ko ari iya
nyir’ubwite kandi ko ari ukuri, igihe:
1° yoherejwe n’umuntu ufite uburenganzira
bwo gukora mu izina rya nyir’ubwite mu
birebana n’iyo nyandiko koranabuhanga;
2° yoherejwe n’uburyo koranabuhanga bwo
kohereza amakuru bwashyizweho na
nyir’ubwite cyangwa mu izina rye ku buryo
byikora mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga;
3° uwohererejwe inyandiko koranabuhanga
abashije kuyigeraho akoresheje uburyo
bwumvikanyweho.

articles.heading: Igihe inyandiko koranabuhanga itakaza agaciro Inyandiko koranabuhanga itakaza agaciro iyo
articles.text:
1° nyir’ubwite yohereje inyandiko ivuguruza
iyo yari yohereje mbere;
2° uwandikiwe yari azi cyangwa yari afite
uburyo bwo kuba yamenya ko inyandiko
koranabuhanga atari iya nyir’ubwite.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa uwohererejwe inyandiko koranabuhanga Uwohererejwe inyandiko koranabuhanga asabwa kwemera ko buri nyandiko koranabuhanga yakiriye
articles.text:
ifatwa nk’inyandiko koranabuhanga nshya, kandi
akayifata atyo keretse iyo yari azi cyangwa
yashoboraga kumenya ko ari inyandiko
koranabuhanga ya mbere yisubiyemo.
Uwohererejwe inyandiko koranabuhanga
ntaryozwa ibijyanye n’iyo nyandiko
koranabuhanga yabonye itamugenewe keretse iyo
ayikoresheje nk’aho yari imugenewe.

articles.heading: Ingaruka z’ihinduka cyangwa ikosa ry’inyandiko koranabuhanga Iyo uwanditse n’uwandikiwe bumvikanye
articles.text:
gukoresha uburyo bwo kwita ku mutekano
w’amakuru ku byerekeye inyandiko koranabuhanga
kandi umwe muri bo agakoresha ubwo buryo, ariko
undi ntabukoreshe, uwabukoresheje ntabazwa
ingaruka z’ihinduka cyangwa z’ikosa ry’inyandiko
koranabuhanga.
Uwanditse cyangwa uwandikiwe inyandiko
koranabuhanga ashobora kwirinda ingaruka
z’inyandiko igihe ikosa ryakozwe mu nyandiko
koranabuhanga kandi nta buryo bwateganyijwe bwo
kurikosora, yihutira kumenyesha iryo kosa,
cyangwa gutanga amabwiriza yo gusenya inyandiko
yagaragayemo ikosa cyangwa kuyigarura.

articles.heading: Icyemezo cy’iyakira ry’inyandiko koranabuhanga Iyo uwanditse inyandiko koranabuhanga abisabye
articles.text:
cyangwa abyemeye, uwandikiwe iyo nyandiko
yemeza ko yayibonye.
Igihe uwanditse atumvikanye n’uwandikiwe ko
icyemezo cy’iyakira gitangwa mu buryo bwihariye,
icyo cyemezo gishobora gutangwa hakoreshejwe:
1º itumanaho uwandikiwe aha uwanditse,
ubutumwa koranabuhanga bwiyohereza
cyangwa ubundi buryo;
2º imyitwarire y’uwandikiwe yereka
uwanditse ku buryo buhagije, ko yabonye
inyandiko koranabuhanga yamwoherereje.
Igihe uwanditse yasabye ko inyandiko
koranabuhanga ari ngombwa mu kwemeza ko
yabonye inyandiko yamwoherereje, iyo nyandiko
ifatwa nk’aho itoherejwe igihe cyose nta nyandiko
yohereje ihamya ko yabonye iyo nyandiko yakiriwe.

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’inyandiko koranabuhanga nk’ikimenyetso Mu rwego rw’amategeko, inyandiko koranabuhanga
articles.text: yemerwa kandi ihabwa agaciro nk’ikimenyetso.

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’umukono koranabuhanga Iyo bibaye ngombwa ko inyandiko koranabuhanga ibaho umukono w’umuntu, umukono
articles.text:
koranabuhanga wemerwa kandi ugahabwa agaciro
nk’ikimenyetso mu rwego rw’amategeko iyo:
1° uburyo bukoreshejwe bugaragaza umuntu
wohereje iyo nyandiko kandi ko yemera ibiri
muri iyo nyandiko;
2° ubwo buryo bwizewe kandi ari bwo bwari
buteganyijwe mu gukora cyangwa gutangaza
inyandiko koranabuhanga hakurikijwe
amasezerano.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku mukono no ku cyemezo cy’umukono koranabuhanga Umuntu wese afite uburenganzira ku mukono no ku
articles.text:
cyemezo cy’umukono koranabuhanga igihe yujuje
ibisabwa.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza
agena ibisabwa mu guhabwa umukono n’icyemezo
cy’umukono koranabuhanga

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’icyemezo n’umukono koranabuhanga mvamahanga Icyemezo cyangwa umukono koranabuhanga
articles.text:
bitangiwe hanze y’igihugu bigira agaciro kamwe
imbere y’amategeko nk’ak’ibyemezo bitangiwe mu
gihugu iyo byujuje ibisabwa n’amategeko.
Mu guhamya ko icyemezo koranabuhanga cyangwa
umukono koranabuhanga bitanga icyizere kiri ku
rugero rumwe, hakurikizwa uburyo bugenderwaho
mu rwego mpuzamahanga.
Iyo impande bireba zumvikanye hagati yazo ku
mikoreshereze y’ubwoko bumwe na bumwe
bw’umukono cyangwa ibyemezo koranabuhanga,
ayo masezerano afatwa nk’ahagije mu kwemera
umukono cyangwa icyemezo mvamahanga iyo
atanyuranyije n’amategeko akurikizwa aho icyo
cyemezo kigomba gukoreshwa.

articles.heading: Iyemeza n’iyakirwa by’ubutumwa n’umukono koranabuhanga n’itangwa ry’icyemezo Igihe bisabwa n’itegeko ko ubutumwa cyangwa
articles.text:
umukono koranabuhanga bisuzumwa, byakirwa,
byemezwa cyangwa bishyirwa mu bikorwa
hokozwe indahiro, biba byujuje ibisabwa iyo
biherekejwe n’umukono koranabuhanga wa noteri
cyangwa undi muntu wese ubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Uburemere bungana bw’imikono koranabuhanga Imikono koranabuhanga yose iremewe hatitawe ku ikoranabuhanga ryakoreshejwe mu gihe ryubahirije
articles.text:
ibiteganywa n’itegeko, keretse iyo hari amasezerano
abiteganya ukundi.

articles.heading: Imyifatire ya nyir’umukono Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’andi mategeko
articles.text:
1° nyir’umukono akora uko ashoboye kose
ntakoreshe igikoresho cyangwa amakuru
anyuranyije n’umukono yatanze;
2° nyir’umukono amenyesha mu buryo bwihuse abo
bireba ikibazo cyaba cyavutse, gishobora kuvuka
cyangwa icyahindutse mu bikoresho cyangwa
amakuru akora umukono mu buryo
koranabuhanga;
3° uwahawe icyemezo cyo gukora umukono
koranabuhanga agomba kwitwararika ko
ibyashingiweho ahabwa icyo cyemezo akomeza
kubyubahiriza igihe cyose azaba agikoresha uwo
mukono.

articles.heading: Imyifatire y’utanga icyemezo Amabwiriza y’Urwego ngenzuramikorere agena imyitwarire y’ubuyobozi butanga icyemezo hitawe
articles.text:
cyane cyane kuri ibi bikurikira:
1° gutuma ubuyobozi butanga icyemezo
bwubahiriza inshingano zabwo;
2° gutuma ubuyobozi butanga icyemezo
bukorana ubushishozi mu kugaragaza
ibikoresho byose byakoreshejwe bifitanye
isano n’icyemezo bigaragaza igihe cyose
kizamara bikanagaragara muri icyo
cyemezo;
3° gutuma ubuyobozi butanga icyemezo
buteganya uburyo bworoshye bwatuma
umuntu wese wifuza amakuru ku cyemezo
cyatanzwe ayabona.

articles.heading: Gukora imfunguzo z’inyabubiri
articles.text:
Igihe umufatabuguzi akoze imfunguzo z’inyabubiri,
urufunguzo rusange rushyirwa mu cyemezo kandi
akarwemeza. Umufatabuguzi akora imfunguzo
z’inyabubiri akoresheje uburyo bw’icyizere
bwemezwa n’ubuyobozi butanga icyemezo.

articles.heading: Ukwemerwa kw’icyemezo Umufatabuguzi afatwa ko yemeye icyemezo iyo atangaje cyangwa yemeye ko icyemezo gitangazwa
articles.text:
ku muntu uwo ari we wese cyangwa gishyirwa mu
bubiko.

articles.heading: Ibungabunga n’irindwa ry`urufunguzo rwihariye Umufatabuguzi ugaragara mu cyemezo agomba kwitwararika akomeza kugenzura urufunguzo
articles.text:
rwihariye rufitanye isano n’urufunguzo rusange,
akirinda kurumenyekanisha mu gukora umukono
ukozwe mu mibare.

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa cyangwa ivanwaho ry’icyemezo Umufatabuguzi wemeye icyemezo, agomba gusaba bidatinze ubuyobozi bwamuhaye icyemezo,
articles.text:
guhagarika cyangwa kuvanirwaho icyemezo igihe
urufunguzo rwihariye ruhwanye n’urufunguzo
rusange ruvugwa mu cyemezo rwangiritse, rukaba
nta cyizere rugifitiwe.

articles.heading: Kubungabunga umutekano w’ubutumwa koranabuhanga hakoreshejwe umukono ukozwe mu mibare Igice cy’ubutumwa koranabuhanga cyashyizweho
articles.text:
umukono ukozwe mu mibare gifatwa nk’ikirindiwe
umutekano igihe umukono ukozwe mu mibare
ubungabunzwe nk’umukono koranabuhanga nk’uko
bisobanurwa n’iri tegeko.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ihererekanya koranabuhanga

articles.heading: Gukora amasezerano yemewe y’ihererekanya koranabuhanga Mu rwego rwo gukora amasezerano y’ihererekanya
articles.text:
koranabuhanga, uretse igihe byemejwe ukundi
n’impande zombi, gutanga no kwemera ibyatanzwe
bishobora gukorwa mu buryo koranabuhanga.
Igihe ubutumwa koranabuhanga bukoreshwa mu
gukora amasezerano, ayo masezerano aba afite
agaciro uretse igihe impande zombi
zabyemeranyijweho ukundi cyangwa igihe
amategeko abiteganya ukundi.

articles.heading: Amasezerano ku ihererekanya koranabuhanga ryikora Mu ihererekanya koranabuhanga ryikora
articles.text:
1. amasezerano ashobora gukorwa igihe
impande zombi zihuriye ku gikorwa
cyangwa umwe muri bo afite umuhagarariye
mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga. Uhagarariye
umuntu mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga akora
ibisabwa n’amategeko mu gukora
amasezerano;
2. uruhande rukoresha uruhagarariye mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga mu gukora amasezerano
rufatwa nk’aho rugengwa n’ayo masezerano
n’ubwo rwaba rutasuzumye ibyakozwe
n’uruhagarariye mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, keretse igihe byari
biteganyijwe ko ayo amasezerano ashobora
gusubirwamo n’undi bemeranyijweho mbere
y’uko ahabwa agaciro.

articles.heading: Uguta agaciro kw’amasezerano ku ihererekanya koranabuhanga Amasezerano nta gaciro aba afite iyo umuntu
articles.text:
ukorana n’uhagarariye urundi ruhande mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga yibeshye mu gihe yakoraga
ubutumwa koranabuhanga kandi:
1º uhagarariye urundi ruhande akaba
ataratanze umwanya wo gufasha uwibeshye
kutibeshya cyangwa kuvanaho uko
kwibeshya;
2º uwibeshye yamenyesheje urundi ruhande
hakiri kare ko habayeho kwibeshya;
3º uwibeshye yakoze ibishoboka byose harimo
intambwe zo kubahiriza amabwiriza
y’urundi ruhande kugira ngo ibyakozwe
bigaruke cyangwa bivanweho;
4º uwibeshye atarakoresheje cyangwa
atarakiriye inyungu iyo ari yose iturutse ku
rundi ruhande.

articles.heading: Guhindura amasezerano y’ihererekanya koranabuhanga Ingingo iyo ari yo yose igize amasezerano
articles.text:
y’ihererekanya koranabuhanga ishobora guhinduka
igihe abayagiranye babyumvikanyeho.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo kohereza ubutumwa Iyo nta kundi byumvikanyweho hagati y’uwohereje n’uwohererejwe ubutumwa, igihe ubutumwa
articles.text:
bwohererejwe ni igihe bwinjiriye mu buryo
koranabuhanga butagenzurwa n’uwabwohereje.
Icyo gihe gifatwa gutyo n’iyo ubutumwa
koranabuhanga bugomba kunyura mu ruhererekane
rw’iyoherezwa koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo kwakira ubutumwa Iyo nta kundi byumvikanyweho hagati y’uwohereje ubutumwa n’ubwohererejwe, igihe cyo kwakira
articles.text:
ubutumwa kigenwa ku buryo bukurikira:
1° igihe uwohererejwe ubutumwa yagaragaje
urusobe rw’ikoranabuhanga inyandiko
izakirirwaho, ukwakirwa kuba kwabaye
igihe ubutumwa bwinjiye muri urwo rusobe
rwagenwe;
2° iyo ubutumwa bwoherejwe mu buryo
bukoresha ikoranabuhanga
bw’uwohererejwe butari uburyo
koranabuhanga yagennye, ubutumwa buba
bwakiriwe igihe cyose abuboneye;
3° igihe uwohererejwe ubutumwa nta rusobe
rw’ikoranabuhanga yatanze rwo
kwakirirwaho, ubutumwa bwakirwa igihe
bwinjiye mu rusobe rw’ikoranabuhanga
abarizwaho.

articles.heading: Ahantu ubutumwa bwohererejwe n’aho bwakiririwe Iyo nta bundi buryo bwumvikanyweho hagati y’uwohererejwe ubutumwa n’uwabwohereje,
articles.text:
bifatwa ko ubutumwa bwohererejwe aho
uwabwohereje akorera kandi bukakirirwa aho
uwohererejwe akorera nk’uko biteganyijwe mu
buryo bukurikira:
1° iyo uwohereje ubutumwa cyangwa
uwabwohererejwe afite ahantu henshi
akorera, ahantu akorera ni ahafitanye isano
ya hafi n’ubutumwa bwoherejwe, bitaba
ibyo hakarebwa ahari icyicaro gikuru;
2° iyo uwohereje ubutumwa cyangwa
uwabwohererejwe adafite ahantu akorera,
harebwa aho atuye.
Icyiciro cya 4: Kurengera umuguzi

articles.heading: Amakuru agomba gutangwa Umuntu utanga ibintu cyangwa serivisi kugira ngo bigurishwe, bikodeshwe cyangwa bihererekanywe
Guha umuguzi umwanya wo gushishoza Umucuruzi agomba guha umuguzi umwanya wo
Igihe cyo gusesa amasezerano Mu gihe cy’iminsi irindwi (7), umuguzi ashobora gusesa ihererekanya koranabuhanga n’andi
articles.text:
masezerano y’inguzanyo agamije kugura ibicuruzwa
ashamikiye kuri iryo hererekanya. Iyo minsi ibarwa
uhereye:
1º ku itariki yakiriyeho ibicuruzwa;
2º nyuma yo kwemeranywa ku masezerano yo
gutanga serivisi.
Iyo habayeho gusesa amasezerano, umuguzi atanga
gusa ubwishyu bwo gusubizayo ibicuruzwa.
Iyo kwishyura ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi
byakozwe mbere y’uko umuguzi akoresha
uburenganzira buvuzwe mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi
ngingo, umuguzi yemerewe kwishyurwa mu gihe
cy’iminsi mirongo itatu (30) kuva iseswa ribayeho.

articles.heading: Ubutumwa bw’ubucuruzi butasabwe Umuntu utanga ku muguzi ubutumwa bw’ubucuruzi butasabwe, aha umuguzi uburenganzira bwo
articles.text:
kwanga kwandikwa ku rutonde rw’abohererezwa
ubutumwa bw’uwo muntu, agaragaza kandi ku
buryo busobanutse uko yabonye amakuru bwite
y’umuguzi mu gihe bisabwe n’umuguzi.

articles.heading: Iyubahirizwa ry’amasezerano y’iyoherezwa ry’ibicuruzwa Uretse igihe abakoze amasezerano babyumvikanye
articles.text:
ukundi, umucuruzi agomba gushyira mu bikorwa
ibyo asabwa mu gihe cy’iminsi mirongo itatu (30)
nyuma y’itariki umucuruzi yakiriyeho inyandiko
imutegeka kubikora,
Igihe umucuruzi ananiwe kubahiriza ibyo ategetswe
mu gihe cy’iminsi mirongo itatu (30) cyangwa mu
gihe cyumvikanyweho, umuguzi ashobora gusesa
amasezerano nyuma yo kurangira kw’icyo gihe
amaze gutanga integuza yanditse y’igihe cy’iminsi
irindwi (7).
Iyo umucuruzi adashobora kubahiriza amasezerano
yitwaje ko ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi yasabwe
bitaboneka, agomba guhita abimenyesha umuguzi
akanamusubiza amafaranga y’ikiguzi yaba
yaratanze mu gihe cy’iminsi mirongo itatu (30)
ikurikira itariki y’iryo menyeshwa.

articles.heading: Iyubahirizwa ry’amategeko y’ibindi bihugu Kurengera umuguzi biteganywa muri uyu mutwe werekeye iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi
articles.text:
koranabuhanga byubahirizwa hatitawe ku mategeko
y’ibindi bihugu yakoreshejwe mu masezerano
yumvikanyweho.

articles.heading: Kutabangamira uburenganzira Ingingo y’amasezerano ibangamira uburenganzira buteganywa muri uyu mutwe werekeye iterambere
articles.text:
rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi koranabuhanga nta
gaciro igira.

articles.heading: Gutanga ikirego Umuguzi ashobora kugeza, ku rwego rubishinzwe, ikirego kirebana na serivisi z’itumanaho
articles.text:
koranabuhanga.
Icyiciro cya 5: Serivisi z’itumanaho
koranabuhanga za Leta

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’ubutumwa koranabuhanga n’iyoherezwa ry’inyandiko Urwego rwose rw’ubuyobozi bw’Igihugu cyangwa
articles.text:
ikigo cya Leta bishobora gutanga uruhushya
cyangwa icyemezo icyo ari cyo cyose cyangwa
bigateganya uburyo bwo kwishyura hakoreshejwe
inyandiko n’ihererekanya koranabuhanga
bitanyuranyije n’ibikubiye muri iri tegeko.

articles.heading: Ibyitabwaho mu gutangaza mu Igazeti ya Leta Mu gihe urwego rw’ubuyobozi cyangwa ikigo cya Leta gihisemo gukora imirimo ivugwa mu ngingo
articles.text:
ibanziriza iyi, bishobora gutangazwa mu Igazeti ya
Leta hitawe kuri ibi bikurikira:
1° uburyo ubutumwa bukorwa, bugera aho
bwoherejwe, bubikwa cyangwa butangwa
n’uko bwaba bumeze;
2° ubwoko bw’umukono busabwa gukoreshwa
n’uburyo uwo mukono ugomba guherekeza
ubutumwa mu gihe ubwo butumwa
bugomba gushyirwaho umukono;
3° umwirondoro cyangwa ibigomba
kubahirizwa n’utanga serivisi zemeza
umwimerere wemerewe gukora ako kazi;
4° uburyo bunoze bwo gukora igenzura ku
mwimerere w’ubutumwa koranabuhanga
n’uburyo bwo kwishyurana, kubungabunga
umutekano wabyo no kubigirira ibanga;
5° bindi byose bisabwa ku butumwa
koranabuhanga cyangwa uburyo bwo
kwishyurana.
Icyiciro cya 6: Amabwiriza agenga abatanga
serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga

articles.heading: Uruhushya rwo gutanga icyemezo koranabuhanga Umuntu wemerewe gushyiraho uburyo bwo gutanga icyemezo koranabuhanga ni ufite uruhushya
articles.text:
rutangwa n’Urwego ngenzuramikorere ruvugwa
muri iri tegeko. Ubirenzeho ahanwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza
agena igihe uruhushya rumara, igihe ingingo zarwo
zivugururirwa, amafaranga arutangwaho,
ibikurikizwa kugira ngo rutangwe, ibisabwa mu
gihe cyo kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’umutungo,
impamvu zo kwanga kurutanga, uburyo bwo
kurwamburwa no kuruhagarikirwa n’uburyo
bijuririrwa.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa uwahawe uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga Urwego ngenzuramikorere, rushingiye ku
articles.text:
byangombwa bisabwa, rushobora gutanga
uruhushya ku bantu, baba ab’ingeri zagenwe
cyangwa umuntu ku giti cye, rwo gutanga serivisi
z’ibyemezo koranabuhanga.
Ufite uruhushya asabwa:
1° gukoresha ibikoresho n’uburyo burinda
kirogoya no gukoreshwa nabi kwabyo;
2° gutanga icyizere ko serivisi atanga
zishobora kurangiza imirimo isabwa
gukorwa;
3° kubahiriza uburyo bwashyizweho, bwo
kwizeza ko ibanga n’uburenganzira
bwihariwe n’imikono koranabuhanga
ikozwe mu mibare byubahirizwa.

articles.heading: Iyemerwa ry’icyemezo koranabuhanga mvamahanga Urwego ngenzuramikorere ni rwo rwemera icyemezo koranabuhanga mvamahanga hakurikijwe
articles.text:
amategeko ateganya ko umugenzuzi ashobora
kwemeza ubuyobozi butanga icyemezo buturuka
hanze y’u Rwanda igihe bwujuje ibisabwa.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere, mu gihe rugenzura
abatanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga
mvamahanga, rushobora kwifashisha n’abandi
bakozi ba Leta iyo bibaye ngombwa.

articles.heading: Amabwiriza atangwa n’Urwego ngenzuramikorere Mu rwego rwo kubahiriza amategeko, Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushobora gutegeka mu nyandiko
articles.text:
utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga, gufata
imyanzuro ikwiye cyangwa guhagarika ibikorwa
bye igihe bibaye ngombwa.

articles.heading: Kwerekana inyandiko n’amakuru Urwego ngenzuramikorere cyangwa umukozi warwo wabiherewe uburenganzira ashobora
articles.text:
1º gusaba utanga serivisi z’icyemezo
koranabuhanga kugaragaza amajwi
yafashwe, amakonti, amakuru abitse ku
buryo koranabuhanga, ashobora kandi
gusuzuma no kugenzura cyangwa gukora
kopi ya buri kintu;
2º gusaba utanga serivisi z’ibyemezo
koranabuhanga kugaragaza inyandiko
ikubiyemo umwirondoro w’umuntu urebwa
n’ibyaha byakozwe mu rwego rw’ikoreshwa
ry’ibyemezo koranabuhanga;
3º gukora iperereza mu gihe bibaye ngombwa;
4º kubika mu gihe asanga ari ngombwa,
amakuru yabitswe ku buryo koranabuhanga
cyangwa inyandiko yose ivugwa muri iyi
ngingo.

articles.heading: Ububasha bwo gukoresha mudasobwa n’amakuru yabitswe ku buryo koranabuhanga Igihe bibaye ngombwa, Urwego ngenzuramikorere
articles.text:
cyangwa umukozi wese ubifitiye ububasha
ashobora:
1° kwinjira ahantu hose utanga serivisi
z’ibyemezo koranabuhanga akorera;
2° kwinjira akagenzura ihuriro rya mudasobwa
n’ibikoresho akeka ko byakoreshejwe;
3° gukoresha cyangwa gutanga uburenganzira
bwo gukoresha iryo huriro rya mudasobwa
mu gushakisha amakuru arimo cyangwa
atangwa muri iryo huriro;
4° gusaba ubuyobozi cyangwa undi mukozi
ubifitiye uburenganzira, bafite impamvu
zumvikana zo gukeka ko yakoresheje iryo
huriro rya mudasobwa cyangwa umuntu
urishinzwe cyangwa ufite aho ahuriye
n’imikorere y’iryo huriro rya mudasobwa
kumufasha.
Icyiciro cya 7: Inshingano z’inzego zitanga
icyemezo

articles.heading: Imenyekanisha Utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga amenyekanisha ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
1° icyemezo cye kirimo urufunguzo
koranabuhanga rusange ruhuye
n’urufunguzo rwihariye rukoreshwa
n’utanga serivisi z’icyemezo
koranabuhanga;
2° inyandiko igaragaza uburyo atanga
icyemezo;
3° ivanwaho cyangwa ihagarikwa ry’icyemezo
cye;
4° ikintu cyose gishobora kubangamira
icyizere kigirirwa icyemezo cyatanzwe
n’ubuyobozi cyangwa ubushobozi
bw’abatanga serivisi z’icyemezo
koranabuhanga mu kurangiza inshingano
zabo.

articles.heading: Gutanga icyemezo Utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga ashobora guha icyemezo umufatabuguzi ucyifuza iyo
articles.text:
1º yabisabwe n’uwo mufatabuguzi;
2º yubahirije ibisabwa.

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa ry’icyemezo Utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga, ashobora guhita ahagarika icyemezo cyahawe
articles.text:
umufatabuguzi iyo abisabwe na nyir’ubwite
cyangwa uwo yabihereye uburenganzira, keretse iyo
babyumvikanyeho ukundi.

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’icyemezo Utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga ashobora kuvanaho icyemezo cyahawe umufatabuguzi nyuma
articles.text:
yo kugenzura ko ubisaba ari we nyirubwite cyangwa
ari we wabiherewe uburenganzira.

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’icyemezo ritumvikanyweho Utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga ashobora kuvanaho icyemezo cyahawe umufatabuguzi
Kumenyesha ihagarikwa cyangwa ivanwaho ry’icyemezo Utanga serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga iyo
articles.text:
ahagaritse cyangwa avanyeho icyemezo, agomba
guhita atanga itangazo ry’iryo hagarikwa cyangwa
ry’iryo vanwaho mu bubiko bwose bwagenwe.

articles.heading: Amabwiriza agenga imyitwarire mu itangwa rya serivisi z’icyemezo koranabuhanga Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza
articles.text:
agenga imyitwarire mu itangwa rya serivisi
z’icyemezo koranabuhanga. Ayo mabwiriza agomba
gutangazwa mu Igazeti ya Leta.
Icyiciro cya 8: Aho uburyozwe bugarukira

articles.heading: Aho uburyozwe bw’utanga serivisi y’icyemezo koranabuhanga bugarukira Uburyozwe bw’utanga serivisi y’icyemezo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga ntiburebana n’ibi bikurikira:
1° igihombo gitewe n’ubwizere bw’umukono
ukozwe mu mibare w’umufatabuguzi utari
wo;
2° mu gihe umufatabuguzi yarengeje umubare
ugenwa n’icyemezo nk’uko biteganywa
n’aho ubwizere bugarukira.

articles.heading: Aho uburyozwe bw’utanga serivisi z’imiyoboro koranabuhanga bugarukira Utanga serivisi z’imiyoboro koranabuhanga
articles.text:
ntaryozwa ibikubiye mu nyandiko cyangwa
amakuru koranabuhanga yanyujijwe cyangwa
yabitswe ku muyoboro we n’undi muntu keretse iyo
atujuje inshingano ze.

articles.heading: Aho Uburyozwe bugarukira mu buryo bwo kubika amakuru bufasha kuyabona vuba Utanga serivisi ntaryozwa inyandiko koranabuhanga
articles.text:
ibitse mu buryo bwikoresha cyangwa ibitse mu gihe
gito, iyo ikigamijwe mu kubika iyo nyandiko
koranabuhanga ari ukuyoherereza abandi bantu
bayisabye, igihe cyose utanga serivisi:
1º atahinduye iyo nyandiko;
2º yujuje ibisabwa mu kugera ku nyandiko
koranabuhanga;
3º akurikiza amabwiriza arebana no
kuvugurura inyandiko koranabuhanga
bisobanuye mu buryo buzwi n’abantu
benshi kandi busanzwe bukoreshwa;
4º atabusanyije n’ikoreshwa
ry’ikoranabuhanga ryemewe n’amategeko,
rizwi n’abantu benshi kandi risanzwe
rikoreshwa kugira ngo abone amakuru
arebana n’ikoreshwa ry’inyandiko
koranabuhanga;
5º akuraho cyangwa adatuma umuntu agera ku
nyandiko koranabuhanga yabitse amaze
kubona inyandiko ibimusaba nk’uko
biteganywa muri iri tegeko.

articles.heading: Aho uburyozwe bugarukira mu gucumbikira amakuru Utanga serivisi zirimo kubika inyandiko koranabuhanga zatanzwe n’ugenewe serivisi
articles.text:
ntaryozwa ibyangiritse bitewe n’amakuru yabitswe
bisabwe n’ugenewe serivisi, igihe cyose utanga
serivisi agaragaje ko:
1º atazi ko ayo makuru cyangwa igikorwa
gifitanye isano n’ayo makuru hari uwo
bibangamira;
2º atazi ibikorwa cyangwa impamvu zateye
igikorwa cyangwa amakuru binyuranyije
n’amategeko;
3º amaze kubona inyandiko ibimusaba akuraho
vuba amakuru cyangwa agatuma nta
wongera kugera kuri ayo makuru.

articles.heading: Aho uburyozwe bugarukira ku byifashishwa mu gushaka amakuru Utanga serivisi ntaryozwa ibyangiritse igihe ahuje
articles.text:
abakoresha serivisi ze n’urundi rubuga rwa interineti
badafitanye isano, rufite inyandiko koranabuhanga
cyangwa ibikorwa bitujuje ibisabwa n’amategeko,
hakoreshejwe ibikoresho byagenewe kubika
amakuru arimo mu gihe agaragaza ko:
1º atazi ko ayo makuru cyangwa igikorwa
gifitanye isano n’ayo makuru hari uwo
bibangamira;
2º atazi ibikorwa cyangwa impamvu zateye
igikorwa kibangamye cyangwa ubwoko
bw’ibangama rigaragara mu nyandiko
koranabuhanga;
3º atakiriye inyungu y’amafaranga ifitanye
isano n’igikorwa kibangamye;
4º akuraho cyangwa agatuma amakuru
afitanye isano n’inyandiko koranabuhanga
atongera kugaragara nyuma y’igihe
gikwiye, amaze kumenya ko iyo nyandiko
koranabuhanga bifitanye isano ibangamiye
uburenganzira bw’umuntu.

articles.heading: Gusaba kuvanaho amakuru abangamye Ubangamiwe amenyesha igikorwa kinyuranyije n’amategeko mu nyandiko ishyikirizwa utanga
Aho ubugenzuzi bugarukira Utanga serivisi ntasabwa kugenzura ubutumwa koranabuhanga ashyikirijwe n’uburyo bwe
articles.text:
bw’imikorere kugira ngo hemezwe niba iryo
shyikirizwa rifatwa nk’icyaha cyangwa rituma
habaho uburyozwe, keretse abisabwe n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha cyangwa biri mu masezerano.
Icyiciro cya 9: Imicungire y’izina ndangarubuga
ry’u rwanda

articles.heading: Uruhushya rwo gucunga izina ndangarubuga n’andi mazina arushamikiyemo Urwego ngenzuramikorere rutanga uruhushya rwo
articles.text:
gucunga izina ndangarubuga rwa interineti n’izindi
zirushamikiyeho ku bantu babifitiye ububasha,
ryaba ari itsinda runaka cyangwa umuntu ku giti
cye, rumaze kubona ubusabe mu nyandiko kandi
hagendewe ku bisabwa byagenwe.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gukemura impaka Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza agena uburyo bwo gukemura impaka ku bijyanye
articles.text:
n’ikoreshwa ry’izina ndangarubuga ry’ahantu.
Icyiciro cya 10: Ikoreshwa nabi rya mudasobwa
n’ibyaha bijyanye na ryo

articles.heading: Kugera ku buryo butemewe ku makuru abitse mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga Umuntu ntiyemererwa kugera ku makuru muri
Kugera ku buryo koranabuhanga hagamijwe gukora icyaha Umuntu wese ugira icyo akora ku buryo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga, afite umugambi wo kugera kuri
porogaramu cyangwa amakuru abitse mu buryo
koranabuhanga agamije gukora icyaha, ahanwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko
ahana.

articles.heading: Kugera no gukoresha bitemewe serivisi za mudasobwa Umuntu wese, icyo yakoresha cyose, atabyemerewe
articles.text:
akagera ku buryo koranabuhanga abizi, agamije
kubona serivisi izo ari zo zose za mudasobwa ku
buryo buziguye cyangwa butaziguye, igikorwa
cyangwa amakuru ari mu buryo koranabuhanga aba
akoze icyaha. Ahanwa hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe
mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana.
Icyakora, umuntu ntacyo yaryozwa mu gihe
agaragaza uburenganzira bwo kugera ku makuru
yahawe n’uwayohereje, n’uwo agenewe, cyangwa
yabikoze yishingikirije ububasha ahabwa n’itegeko.

articles.heading: Impinduka zitemewe z’amakuru abitswe ku ihuriro rya mudasobwa Umuntu wese, abizi, ukora igikorwa gitera
articles.text:
impinduka zitemewe z’amakuru abitswe ku ihuriro
rya mudasobwa, aba akoze icyaha gihanwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko
ahana.

articles.heading: Kwangiza cyangwa kubangamira kugera ku mikorere y’Ihuriro rya mudasobwa Umuntu wese, utabiherewe uruhushya n’itegeko
articles.text:
cyangwa ngo abisonerwe na ryo, agakora igikorwa
kigira ingaruka mu buryo buziguye cyangwa
butaziguye zo kwangiza, gutesha, kubuza,
kubangamira ikoreshwa ry’ihuriro rya mudasobwa,
cyangwa kubuza kugera, cyangwa kwangiza
porogaramu cyangwa inkuru ibitswe mu buryo
koranabuhanga, aba akoze icyaha gihanwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko
ahana.

articles.heading: Gutunga bitemewe ihuriro koranabuhanga, amakuru n’ibikoresho bigendana na ryo Umuntu wese, abizi, ucura, ugurisha, utanga
articles.text:
hagamijwe gukoreshwa, utumiza mu mahanga,
ukwirakwiza, cyangwa se utuma ihuriro
koranabuhanga cyangwa ikindi gikoresho
koranabuhanga kiboneka, utunze amakuru yose
cyangwa porogaramu, agamije gukora ayo makuru
cyangwa porogaramu, ubwe cyangwa undi
hagamijwe gukora icyaha, aba akoze icyaha
gihanwa hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo
cy’amategeko ahana.

articles.heading: Ubujura, uburiganya n’inyandiko mpimbano hakoreshejwe mudasobwa Umuntu wese ukoresheje mudasobwa cyangwa
articles.text:
ikindi gikoresho cy’ikoranabuhanga, ukoze
uburiganya, ukoze cyangwa akoroshya ikorwa
ry’inyandiko mpimbano aba akoze icyaha gihanwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko
ahana.

articles.heading: Kumena ibanga ry’urufunguzo Umuntu wese, abizi neza, umena ibanga ry’urufunguzo, uhishura urufunguzo, ugera ku
articles.text:
ijambo rihishwe, cyangwa ubundi buryo bwatuma
agera kuri porogaramu cyangwa andi makuru ari ku
ihuriro koranabuhanga, aba akoze icyaha, iyo :
1º agamije inyungu itemewe;
2º agamije impamvu itemewe n’amategeko;
3º azi neza ko bishobora kugira uwo
byangiriza.
Umuntu wese uhamwe n’iki cyaha ahanwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko
ahana.

articles.heading: Ihindura ry’ibirango bya telefoni zigendanwa Umuntu wese, abizi cyangwa abishaka, utari uwakoze izo telefoni cyangwa atarabiherewe
articles.text:
uburenganzira n’uwazikoze, uhindura ibirango bya
telefoni zigendanwa cyangwa uburyo bwo
kubigeraho aba akoze icyaha gihanwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana.

articles.heading: Gutangaza amakuru y’urukozasoni mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga Umuntu wese, abizi cyangwa abishaka, utangaza,
articles.text:
wohereza cyangwa utuma hatangazwa mu buryo
koranabuhanga, ubutumwa bwose bw’urukozasoni
aba akoze icyaha gihanwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganyijwe mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana.

articles.heading: Amabwiriza agenga umutekano w’urusobe rwa mudasobwa Haseguriwe ibiteganywa muri iri tegeko, Minisitiri
articles.text:
ashyiraho Iteka rigena ibirebana n’umutekano
w’urusobe rwa mudasobwa.
Icyiciro cya 11: Kurinda amakuru yihariye
y’umuntu

articles.heading: Umutekano wa serivisi rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga Utanga serivisi rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
articles.text:
afatanyije n’utanga serivisi z’imiyoboro
koranabuhanga bagomba gufata ingamba zihariye
zo kurinda umutekano w’izo serivisi n’iyo
miyoboro.
Iyo hagaragara ikibazo ku mutekano wa serivisi
zitangwa, utanga serivisi amenyesha abafatabuguzi
icyo kibazo, ingamba zishoboka umufatabuguzi
yafata kugira ngo akumire icyo kibazo n’igiciro
cy’ibyo umufatabuguzi asabwa mu gukoresha izo
ngamba.
Amakuru yahabwa umufatabuguzi muri uru rwego
agomba kuyahererwa ubuntu, usibye uburyo yaba
yakoresheje ngo ayagereho.

articles.heading: Amahame agenga ikusanya ry’amakuru y’umuntu ku giti cye mu rwego rw’ikoranabuhanga Umugenzuzi w’amakuru agomba kuba afite
articles.text:
uruhushya rwanditse ahawe na nyir’ubwite cyangwa
inzego zibifitiye ububasha rugaragaza icyo
yemerewe gushakaho amakuru, kuyakusanya,
kuyatunganya no kuyabika akaba atayatangaza
atabyemerewe n’itegeko cyangwa na nyir’ubwite
mu nyandiko.
Ushinzwe amakuru ntashobora, mu buryo
elegitoroniki, gusaba, gukusanya, gutunganya no
kubika amakuru ku ngingo itemejwe n’itegeko
itanasabwe gukorwaho ubushakashatsi.
Umugenzuzi w’amakuru amenyesha nyir’ubwite mu
nyandiko impamvu y’ayo makuru, impamvu
ashakwa, akusanywa, atunganywa akanabikwa.
Umugenzuzi w’amakuru ntiyemerewe gukoresha
amakuru y’umuntu ku mpamvu zindi zitari izo
yagenewe, keretse abiherewe uburenganzira na
ny’ir’amakuru, cyangwa abyemerewe n’itegeko.
Umugenzuzi w’amakuru agomba, mu gihe cyose
amakuru agikoreshwa, kubika amakuru bwite
y’umuntu ndetse n’impamvu yakusanyijwe.
Umugenzuzi w’amakuru agomba, mu gihe amakuru
agikoreshwa n’igihe kitari munsi y’umwaka umwe
(1), kubika ibanga ry’ibyo yahishuriye undi muntu
n’itariki ndetse n’impamvu yayamuhishuriye.
Ushinzwe amakuru agomba gusiba amakuru yose
atagikoreshwa.

articles.heading: Iyandikwa ry’abafatabuguzi Uhawe uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho agomba kwandika umwirondoro w’abafatabuguzi
articles.text:
bose cyangwa abafite ikarita ya terefoni bakoresha
imiyoboro ye cyangwa serivisi ze.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rugena amabwiriza
agena uburyo kwiyandikisha bikorwa kandi
rugakurikirana uko bikorwa.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’amakuru y’abafatabuguzi Itangazwa ry’amakuru areba umufatabuguzi ku giti cye rigomba gutangirwa uruhushya na nyir’ubwite
articles.text:
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza
agena itangazwa ry’amakuru y’abafatabuguzi
hitawe ku kurinda amakuru yabo yihariye.

articles.heading: Ibanga ry’ubutumwa Umuntu wese ukoresha umuyoboro w’itumanaho koranabuhanga abujijwe kubika cyangwa kugera ku
articles.text:
makuru abitswe cyangwa anyujijwe mu bikoreshwa
n’umufatabuguzi, keretse uwo mufatabuguzi
yahawe amakuru asobanutse kandi yumvikana ku
mpamvu z’uko kuyabika cyangwa kuyashaka, kandi
yahawe uburyo bwo kwanga ko ayo makuru abikwa
cyangwa agerwaho.
Ibivugwa mu gika kibanziriza iki ntibireba ukubika
cyangwa ukugera ku makuru ku buryo bwa tekiniki
ku mpamvu gusa zo gutwara cyangwa koroshya
itangwa ry’ubutumwa ku muyoboro w’itumanaho
koranabuhanga, cyangwa uko kubika cyangwa
kugera ku makuru ari ngombwa kugira ngo
hatangwe serivisi y’itumanaho koranabuhanga
bisabwe n’umufatabuguzi cyangwa umuguzi.

articles.heading: Aho gukoresha amakuru amwe n’amwe anyuzwa ku muyoboro bigarukira Amakuru anyura ku muyoboro areba abafatabuguzi
articles.text:
cyangwa abayakoresha akaba akoreshwa kandi
akabikwa n’utanga serivisi rusange z’itumanaho
koranabuhanga, ashobora guhanagurwa cyangwa
gukoreshwa ku bundi buryo mu gihe atagikenewe
mu gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho hakurikijwe
amasezerano yakozwe hagati y’utanga serivisi
n’uyihabwa.
Amakuru ari ku muyoboro afitwe n’utanga serivisi
rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga, mu rwego rwo
kuriha serivisi ku mufatabuguzi cyangwa mu rwego
rwo kuriha ifatanyamuyoboro, ashobora
gukoreshwa no kubikwa n’ucuruza itumanaho
kugeza igihe ikurikiranwa ry’ubwishyu rirangiye
burundu.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rugena amabwiriza
agenga ibikwa n’ikoreshwa ry’amakuru bwite
y’abafatabuguzi anyuzwa ku muyoboro.

articles.heading: Inyemezabuguzi Urwego ngenzuramikorere rufite inshingano yo kugenzura ko uburenganzira bw’abafatabuguzi bwo
articles.text:
guhabwa inyemezabuguzi irambuye buhuzwa
n’uburenganzira bwabo ku ibanga ry’amakuru
bwite.
Mu gihe abisabwe n’umufatabuguzi, utanga serivisi
rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga aha
umufatabuguzi inyemezabuguzi itarambuye.

articles.heading: Kugaragaza cyangwa kutagaragaza nomero ya telefoni ihamagaye Utanga serivisi rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
articles.text:
afite inshingano yo guha nta kiguzi, abafatabuguzi
bahamagara uburyo bworoshye bwo guhitamo
kugaragaza cyangwa kutagaragaza nomero ya
telefoni igihe bahamagara.

articles.heading: Kubona cyangwa kutabona nomero ya telefoni ihamagaye Utanga serivisi rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
articles.text:
afite inshingano zo guha nta kiguzi, abafatabuguzi
bahamagarwa uburyo bworoshye bwo guhitamo
kubona cyangwa kutabona nomero ihamagaye igihe
bahamagawe.
Utanga serivisi rusange z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
afite kandi inshingano zo guha umufatabuguzi
wahamagawe uburyo bworoshye bwo gusubizayo
nomero imuhamagara iyo kumenyekana kwa
nomero ihamagara byabujijwe n’ukoresha
itumanaho cyangwa n’umufatabuguzi uhamagara.

articles.heading: Gutanga amakuru ku igaragazwa rya nomero ihamagara Utanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
articles.text:
amenyesha abafatabaguzi ko hariho uburyo bwo
kugaragaza cyangwa kutagaragaza, bwo kubona
cyangwa kutabona nomero ihamagara,
akanabamenyesha uko ubwo buryo buboneka n’uko
bukoreshwa.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye bw’abatanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga mu kugaragaza nomero ihamagarwa n’ihamagara
articles.text:
Utanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
yubahiriza icyifuzo agejejweho n’undi mucuruzi wa
serivisi rusange y’itumanaho koranabuhanga cyo
kumenya uko uburyo bwo kugaragaza nomero
ihamagawe cyangwa ihamagaye buboneka.

articles.heading: Kumenya telefoni zidakenewe Umucuruzi wa serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga, agomba kumenyekanisha nomero yahamagaye
articles.text:
n’umwirondoro wa nyirayo, iyo umufatabuguzi
yasabye ko hamenyekana telefoni atifuza cyangwa
adakeneye kwakira.

articles.heading: Telefoni itabaza Uhamagara kuri nomero z’ubutabazi agomba kugaragaza nomero ye ya telefoni
articles.text:
Haseguriwe ingingo z’amategeko akumira
uburenganzira bw’ikoreshwa n’ibikwa ry’amakuru
y’itumanaho koranabuhanga, utanga serivisi
z’itumanaho koranabuhanga yemerewe kubika
amakuru agaragaza aho uhamagaye atabaza
aherereye.

articles.heading: Telefoni yiyohereza ubwayo ku muntu Umufatabuguzi ku mpamvu zitandukanye ashobora gusaba ko telefoni imuhamagaye yiyohereza ku
articles.text:
muntu babyumvikanyeho.
Uwakira telefoni imwiyoherejeho ashobora gusaba
utanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga
kuyihagarika.
Utanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga agomba
kugenzura ku buntu ko ukohereza iyo telefoni
byahise bihagarara kandi akabimenyesha uwari
wasabye ko iyo telefoni izajya yiyohereza.

articles.heading: Gukoresha telefoni mu gushakisha amasoko ku buryo butaziguye bitabanje kumenyeshwa nyir’uguhamagarwa
articles.text:
Umuntu wese yemerewe gukoresha cyangwa gusaba
gukoresha serivisi rusange z’itumanaho
koranabuhanga mu gushakisha amasoko ku buryo
butaziguye abanje kubimenyesha
nyir’uguhamagarwa.

articles.heading: Ibuzwa ryo gukoresha ubutumwa koranabuhanga mu gushakisha amasoko ku buryo butaziguye Umuntu ntashobora kohereza cyangwa gusaba
articles.text:
kohereza ubutumwa mu rwego rwo gushakisha
amasoko ku buryo butaziguye yitabaje ubutumwa
koranabuhanga iyo:
1° umwirondoro w’umuntu wohereje
ubutumwa wahishwe cyangwa wagizwe
ibanga;
2° aderesi uwohererejwe ubutumwa ashobora
koherezaho ubutumwa bwo guhagarika
itatanzwe.
UMUTWE WA IV: ISAKAZAMAKURU
Icyiciro cya mbere: Igenzura n’ibyiciro bya
serivisi z’isakazamakuru

articles.heading: Igenzura ry’ibigo by’isakazamakuru Inshingano z’Urwego ngenzuramikorere mu bijyanye n’isakazamakuru zigenwa n’Iteka rya
articles.text: Minisitiri w’Intebe.

articles.heading: Ibyiciro bya serivisi z’isakazamakuru Urwego ngenzuramikorere rutanga uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’isakazamajwi cyangwa
Uruhushya rw’isakazamakuru Umuntu wese wifuza gusakaza amakuru mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose agomba gusaba uruhushya
articles.text:
rwabigenewe rutangwa n’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere.

articles.heading: Guhabwa cyangwa kwangirwa uruhushya rw’isakazamakuru Iyo Urwego ngenzuramikorere rusanze usaba
articles.text:
uruhushya yujuje ibisabwa hakurikijwe imirongo
ngenderwaho rwashyizeho rumuha uruhushya.
Aho Urwego ngenzuramikorere rusanze ari
ngombwa ku mpamvu zishingiye ku mategeko
cyangwa z’umutekano rushobora kwima uruhushya
rw’isakazamakuru uwarusabye.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rumaze gufata icyemezo
cyo gutanga cyangwa kudatanga uruhushya,
rubimenyesha uwarusabye mu nyandiko.
Umuntu wese utanyuzwe n’icyemezo cy’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere cyo gutanga cyangwa kudatanga
uruhushya ashobora kukijuririra mu rukiko
rubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Guhererekanya uruhushya no kurusubiza Uruhushya ntirushobora guhererekanywa cyangwa kwegurirwa undi muntu, Urwego ngenzuramikorere
articles.text:
rutabyemeye mu nyandiko.
Ufite uruhushya ashobora kurusubiza igihe icyo ari
cyose abanje kubimenyesha mu nyandiko Urwego
ngenzuramikorere mbere y’uko rurangiza igihe.

articles.heading: Rejisitiri ikoze mu buryo bw’igitabo cyangwa bw’ikoranabuhanga yandikwamo impushya Urwego ngenzuramikorere rubika rejisitiri ikoze mu
articles.text:
buryo bw’igitabo cyangwa bw’ikoranabuhanga
yanditsemo impushya zose
zatanzwe n’ibiziranga byihariye.
Iyi rejisitiri ifunguriwe buri wese wifuza kureba
amakuru ayikubiyemo.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere ruhuza iyi rejisitiri
n’igihe rukandikamo niba uruhushya rwarongerewe
igihe, rwareguriwe undi, rwarasubijwe,
rwarahinduwe, rwarambuwe nyirarwo cyangwa
rwarahagaritswe.
Icyiciro cya 3: Inshingano z’uwahawe uruhushya
n’amabwiriza agenga uruhushya
rw’isakazamakuru

articles.heading: Inshingano n’imikorere by’uwahawe uruhushya Inshingano n’imikorere by’uwahawe uruhushya rw’isakazamakuru bigenwa n’Urwego
articles.text: ngenzuramikorere.

articles.heading: Iyubahirizwa ry’uruhushya n’amabwiriza agena imyitwarire Umuntu wese wahawe uruhushya rwo gusakaza
articles.text:
amakuru agomba kubahiriza ibiri mu ruhushya
yahawe n’amabwiriza agenga imyitwarire muri
serivisi z’isakazamakuru.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rugomba kugenzura uko
iyubahirizwa rivugwa mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi
ngingo rikorwa.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushobora kumva
ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose kirebana n’igenzura
n’ikurikizwa ry’uruhushya ruhabwa
abasakazamakuru.

articles.heading: Ibyemezo bifatirwa abatubahirije amabwiriza Iyo Urwego ngenzuramikorere rusanze uwahawe uruhushya rwo gusakaza amakuru atarubahirije
articles.text:
amabwiriza ari mu ruhushya yahawe, cyangwa
ingingo z’iri tegeko, rugomba kubimumenyesha mu
nyandiko.
Nyuma yo kumva ibisobanuro bye, Urwego
ngenzuramikorere rwemeza uko kutubahiriza
amategeko, rugatangaza ibyo rwagezeho
n’impamvu zabyo.
Rumaze gusuzuma ubwoko, uburemere n’ingaruka
z’uko kutubahiriza amategeko, kandi rumaze kumva
ibisobanuro byatanzwe n’uwahawe uruhushya
cyangwa n’abandi bantu bireba, Urwego
ngenzuramikorere rushobora gufata kimwe cyangwa
byinshi mu byemezo bikurikira rusanga bikwiye:
1° gutangaza ibyo yakosoye, ibyabisimbura
cyangwa ibitekerezo abantu
babyunguranyeho;
2° kumusaba kwitandukanya n’uko
kutubahiriza amategeko, kumuca ihazabu
ikwiranye n’ingaruka z’uko kutubahiriza
amategeko cyangwa kumutegeka gukemura
ibibazo yateje.
Iyo uwahawe uruhushya rwo gusakaza amakuru
atubahirije amabwiriza, Urwego ngenzuramikorere
rushobora kumubuza gutanga serivisi
z’isakazamakuru iyo ari ubwa mbere mu gihe
kidashobora kurenga iminsi mirongo itatu (30).

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa n’ivanwaho ry’uruhushya Igihe cyose Urwego ngenzuramikorere rusanze ari ngombwa ko uruhushya rwatanzwe ruhagarikwa
articles.text:
cyangwa rwamburwa uwaruhawe rubimumenyesha
mu nyandiko rukanamumenyesha n’impamvu
y’icyo cyemezo.
Umuntu wese utanyuzwe n’icyemezo cy’ihagarikwa
cyangwa cy’ivanwaho ry’uruhushya ashobora
kukijuririra mu rukiko rubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Ibirego birebana n’isakazamakuru bishyikirizwa Urwego ngenzuramikorere Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza
articles.text:
agenga uburyo bwo gutanga ibirego, uburyo
bisuzumwa, hamwe n’ibihano ku makosa
yagaragaye.
UMUTWE WA V: SERIVISI Z’IPOSITA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ingingo z’ibanze

articles.heading: Ibintu binyura mu iposita Ubutumwa bunyura mu iposita bushobora kuba
articles.text:
amabaruwa, amakarita y’iposita yoroheje, inyandiko
zicapye, ibinyamakuru, inyandiko zigenewe
gusomwa n’abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, hamwe
n’udupaki dutoya.

articles.heading: Amahame rusange ya serivisi z’amaposita Amahame rusange agenga serivisi z’amaposita ni aya akurikira
Serivisi rusange z’amaposita Serivisi rusange z’amaposita zigizwe na
Ireme rya Serivisi y’amaposita kuri bose Ireme rya serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose ni ugutanga
articles.text:
serivisi iri mu rwego rwiza rwagenwe kandi
igenzuye, itangwa ku buryo buhoraho kandi ku gihe,
keretse mu bihe bidasanzwe, ibyo bigakorwa mu
gihugu hose ku biciro bishobora kwishyurwa na
bose bishyizweho n’urwego rubishinzwe.
Iyo serivisi itangwa hubahirijwe amahame
y’ubutabera, yo kudahagarika imirimo no kuba ku
gihe, hashakishwa uburyo bwiza bujyanye
n’ubukungu n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage.

articles.heading: Ibigize serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose Serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose zigizwe n’imirimo ikorerwa mu gihugu, no ku rwego mpuzamahanga
Serivisi zijyanye n’imari Imirimo y’amaposita ijyanye n’imari igizwe n’ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
1° imirimo ya sheki z’iposita, kimwe
n’imirimo yose y’ifungura no gucunga
amakonti ashobora kubikuzwaho
amafaranga ku buryo bworoshye, ba
nyirayo bagashobora kuyakusanyirizaho
amafaranga hifashishijwe uburyo bwose
bwemewe n’amategeko;
2° imirimo ya manda n’imirimo yose yo
kohereza no kwishyura impapuro
mvunjwafaranga, mu rwego rwo
kohererezanya amafaranga;
3° imirimo yo kwishyuza no kohereza
ubutumwa bwishyuriwe, kimwe n’imirimo
yo kwishyuza gitansi, inyemezabuguzi;
impapuro mvunjwafaranga hamwe n’ibintu
byoherezwa bikishyurwa
n’uwabyohererejwe;
4° imirimo yo kuzigama mu iposita kimwe
n’imirimo yose igamije kwakira amafaranga
y’abantu ku giti cyabo n’ibigo by’imirimo.
Iyo mirimo ikorwa nk’uko biteganywa n’amategeko
abigenga.

articles.heading: Ibitareba ibigo bitanga serivisi z’amaposita Serivisi zikurikira ntizifatwa nka serivisi z’amaposita zigengwa n’iri tegeko
articles.text:
1° gutwara ubutumwa bikozwe n’umwe mu
bakozi b’ikigo, abujyanye cyangwa
abuvanye ku biro cyangwa ku mashami
y’icyo kigo;
2° gutwara ubutumwa bikozwe na za
ambasade n’imiryango mpuzamahanga,
nk’uko amasezerano mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa abiteganya;
3° gutwara ubutumwa abantu cyangwa ibigo
byohererezanya hifashishijwe abakozi
babyo, kwitwarira ubutumwa bikozwe
n’umuntu ku giti cye;
4° gutwara inyandiko ziherekeje imizigo.

articles.heading: Iyishyurwa ry’imirimo itera igihombo Igihombo gituruka ku ikwirakwizwa ry’imirimo y’iposita kuri bose n’ikigo kibishinzwe, yishyurwa
articles.text:
1º n’ikigega kibishinzwe, gikomora umutungo
ku mafaranga atangwa n’ibigo bitanga
serivisi z’amaposita;
2º n’imirimo y’umwihariko ihabwa ikigo
cy’iposita gishinzwe gutanga serivisi
z’amaposita kuri bose.

articles.heading: Serivisi zigamije inyungu rusange Leta ishyiraho ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose imirimo ifitiye
articles.text:
abaturage akamaro, hagamijwe kuyunganira muri
ibi bikurikira:
1° imirimo igomba gukorerwa ubuntu cyangwa
ku mafaranga make ku bagenerwabikorwa
bamwe na bamwe, cyangwa mu rwego rwo
guteza imbere imirimo imwe n’imwe;
2° guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga rishya mu
itangazabumenyi n’itumanaho;
3° gutanga serivisi z’amaposita mu gihugu
hose, ku gihe no ku giciro gikwiye;
4° ibindi byose byagenwa n’inzego zibifitiye
ububasha.
Leta igirana amasezerano n’Ikigo cy’iposita
gishinzwe serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose.
Bitabangamiye ibimaze kuvugwa mu gika cya
mbere cy’iyi ngingo, ikigo gishinzwe gutanga
serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose n’ibindi bigo bitanga
serivisi z’amaposita bigomba kunganira Leta mu
nshingano zikurikira:
1° kurinda imbibi z’igihugu n’umutekano
wacyo;
2° gushyira mu bikorwa politiki ya Leta mu
byerekeye kurengera ibidukikije;
3° gushyira mu bikorwa politiki ya Leta mu
byerekeye itunganywa ry’ubutaka.
Icyiciro cya 3: Imirimo yihariye y’ikigo
gishinzwe ikwirakwiza ry’imirimo y’iposita

articles.heading: Serivisi z’umwihariko Mu rwego rwo gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose, bitabereye umuzigo ikigo kizitanga, icyo kigo
articles.text:
kigenerwa serivisi z’umwihariko nk’ingurane.
Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe rigena urutonde rwa
serivisi z’umwihariko zikorwa n’ikigo gishinzwe
gukwirakwiza serivisi rusange z’amaposita.

articles.heading: Umwihariko mu gukora tembure n’ibindi by’agaciro bijyanye n’amaposita Uburenganzira bwo gukora tembure n’ibindi
articles.text:
by’agaciro bijyanye n’amaposita byanditseho
«Repubulika y’u Rwanda », ikindi kimenyetso
cyose cyangwa ikirango cya Repubulika, buhariwe
gusa ikigo gishinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita
kuri bose.
Iyi ngingo ntibuza ibigo bitanga serivisi z’amaposita
kuri bose gukora utumenyetso tubafasha kwishyuza
serivisi batanga, hubahirijwe amategeko.

articles.heading: Ikimenyetso cy’ubwishyu gishyirwa ku butumwa Ubutumwa bunyujijwe mu iposita bugomba kwishyurirwa igiciro cyose n’ubwohereje,
articles.text:
bugashyirwaho ikimenyetso cy’ubwishyu.
Haseguriwe ibiteganywa n’amasezerano
mpuzamahanga u Rwanda rwashyizeho umukono,
ntihemewe iyoherezwa ry’ubutumwa budafite
ikimenyetso cy’ubwishyu.

articles.heading: Ububasha bwo kugabanya ibiciro ku butumwa burimo ibinyamakuru n’inyandiko zicapye Ikigo cy’Iposita gishinzwe gutanga serivisi
articles.text:
z’amaposita kuri bose gifite ububasha bwo
kugabanya ibiciro ku butumwa burimo
ibinyamakuru n’inyandiko zicapye bisohoka mu
buryo bw’ingarukagihe. Iryo gabanya ry’ibiciro
ntirishobora kurenza mirongo itanu ku ijana (50%)
by’ibiciro byagenwe kuri bene izo nyandiko kandi
rigomba kumenyeshwa Urwego ngenzuramikorere.

articles.heading: Igurishwa ry’impapuro mbonera zikoreshwa mu gusubiza Ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe serivisi rusange
articles.text:
z’amaposita kuri bose ni cyo cyemerewe kugurisha
impapuro mbonera mpuzamahanga zikoreshwa mu
gusubiza, kandi zikavunjwa mu bihugu byose bigize
Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ry’Amaposita mu
matembure angana n’ikimenyetso cy’ubwishyu
bw’ibaruwa isanzwe iri mu rwego rwa mbere
rw’ibiro byoherezwa mu mahanga.
Icyiciro cya 4: Ikigo gishinzwe gutanga serivisi
z’amaposita kuri bose

articles.heading: Igenwa ry’ikigo gishinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe rigena ikigo cy’iposita
articles.text:
gihabwa inshingano yo gutanga serivisi z’amaposita
kuri bose n’igihe iyo nshingano imara.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa ushinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose Ushinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose
articles.text:
agomba kuba nibura yujuje ibi bikurikira:
1° kuba afite amashami ahantu henshi
hashobora kugerwa na bose mu mpande
zose z’igihugu;
2° kuba afite abakozi n’ibikoresho bihagije
byo gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose;
3° kuba afite imari shingiro igenwa n’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere;
4° kuba afite ubushobozi mu bijyanye
n’ubumenyi mu mitangire ya serivisi
z’amaposita;
5° kuba ashobora gutanga serivisi z’amaposita
akurikije amasezerano mpuzamahanga u
Rwanda rwashyizeho umukono;
6° kwishingira ikorwa rya serivisi z’amaposita
kuri bose mu buryo buteganywa
n’inyandiko isobanura ibigomba gukorwa
yemejwe n’Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rusesengura
ibigenderwaho kugira ngo ikigo cy’iposita
gishinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita kuri bose
cyemerwe.

articles.heading: Inshingano yo guhuza ibiro by’iposita n’ibikenerwa no kubiteza imbere Kugira ngo ushinzwe gutanga serivisi z’amaposita
articles.text:
kuri bose ashobore gukwirakwiza serivisi mu
gihugu hose agomba guhuza ibiro by’iposita bye
n’ibikenewe kandi akabyongera, agirana
amasezerano y’ubufatanye n’abakorera mu gihugu
hose, zaba inzego cyangwa ibigo bya Leta, baba
abikorera ku giti cyabo, ashakisha uburyo bwiza
bwo guhuza ubucuruzi akora n’imibereho myiza
y’abaturage.
Icyiciro cya 5: Nyir’ubutumwa, ifungurwa
ry’ubutumwa n’ibibujijwe

articles.heading: Nyir’ubutumwa Uwohereje ubutumwa akomeza kuba nyirabwo kugeza igihe bushyikirijwe uwabwohererejwe
articles.text: keretse iyo biteganyijwe ukundi n’amategeko.

articles.heading: Ubutumwa bwaburiwe nyirabwo n’ifungurwa ryabwo Ubutumwa budashobora gutangwa ku mpamvu izo ari zo zose bwitwa ko bwabuze nyirabwo
articles.text:
Ubutumwa bushobora kudatangwa kubera impamvu
zikurikira:
1° iyo nyir’ubutumwa atazwi;
2° iyo yimutse;
3° iyo aderesi ituzuye;
4° iyo ubwohererejwe abwanze;
5° iyo ubwohererejwe atagiye kubufata;
6° iyo gasutamo itabwemereye gutambuka;
7. izindi mpamvu zagenwa n’amategeko.
Abakora imirimo y’amaposita bemerewe gufungura
gusa ubutumwa butabashije kubonerwa ba
nyirabwo, kandi hagamijwe gusa gushakishamo
ibisobanuro byafasha kumenya uwo bugenewe
cyangwa se gukuramo ibintu bifite agaciro kugira
ngo bibikirwe abo bireba.
Ubutumwa bwafunguwe kubera ko butabashije
gushyikirizwa uwo bugenewe, iyo byagaragaye ko
nta gaciro bufite butwikwa nyuma y’igihe cy’amezi
abiri (2) guhera igihe bwafunguriwe.
Nyuma y’imyaka itanu (5) uhereye igihe ubutumwa
burimo ibintu bifite agaciro bwafunguriwe n’ukora
imirimo y’iposita bushyikirizwa ikigo cy’iposita
gishinzwe gutanga serivisi rusange z’amaposita kuri
bose.
Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite serivisi z’amaposita mu
nshingano ze rigena uburyo ibintu bifite agaciro
byashyikirijwe ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe gutanga
serivisi rusange z’amaposita kuri bose bicungwa.

articles.heading: Ibitemewe gutwarwa n’ibigo by’amaposita Urwego ngenzuramikorere rugena ibitemewe gutwarwa n’ibigo by’iposita
articles.text: Icyiciro cya 6: Ibyerekeye uruhushya

articles.heading: Ibyangombwa by’ibanze Umuntu wese ushaka gutanga serivisi z’amaposita agomba gusaba uruhushya rutangwa n’Urwego
articles.text:
ngenzuramikorere.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho amabwiriza
agaragaza ibyo ushaka uruhushya rwo gutanga
serivisi z’amaposita agomba kuba yujuje.

articles.heading: Isesengura rya dosiye n’itangwa ry’uruhushya Urwego ngenzuramikorere rufite igihe cy’ukwezi
articles.text:
kumwe (1) kuva umunsi rwashyikiririjweho dosiye,
ngo ruyisesengure kandi rube rwatanze igisubizo.
Icyo gihe gishobora kongerwaho ukwezi kumwe (1)
niba ibyatanzwe n’uwasabye bituzuye.
Uruhushya rutangirwa igihe cy’imyaka itanu (5)
ishobora kongerwa. Urwo ruhushya ni urwa
nyirarwo wenyine ntashobora kuruha undi.

articles.heading: Ubwoko bw’impushya Ubwoko bw’impushya bugenwa n’Urwego ngenzuramikorere, haba gukorera mu Rwanda
articles.text: cyangwa gukorera mu mahanga.

articles.heading: Inshingano zikubiye mu ruhushya
Ishyirwa ku gihe ry’amakuru yerekeye impushya Ibyamenyekanyishijwe igihe hasabwaga bwa mbere
articles.text:
uruhushya, bishyirwa ku gihe iyo bibaye ngombwa
bikamenyeshwa Urwego ngenzuramikorere
hakurikijwe amabwiriza rushyiraho.

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’uruhushya Mu gihe utanga serivisi z’amaposita atubahirije ibikubiye mu masezerano, Urwego
articles.text:
ngenzuramikorere, rushobora kumwambura
uruhushya mu gihe bibaye ngombwa.
Icyiciro cya 8: Uburyozwe bw’ikigo cy’iposita

articles.heading: Uburyozwe Ikigo gitanga serivisi z’amaposita kiryozwa amafaranga n’ubutumwa ubwo ari bwo bwose
articles.text:
cyahawe mu gihe ayo mafaranga cyangwa ubwo
butumwa:
1º bitatanzwe ku gihe;
2º byatakaye;
3º byageze kuwo bigenewe bituzuye.
Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushingiye ku mategeko
n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga, rugena uburyo
indishyi zitangwa mu bihe byavuzwe haruguru,
rugena kandi aho uburyozwe bugarukira.

articles.heading: Igihe ntarengwa cyo gukurikirana uburyozwe Gukurikirana uburyozwe bw’ikigo gitanga serivisi
articles.text:
z’amaposita bizima kubera ubusaze mu gihe
cyumvikanyweho ariko kitarenze amezi atandatu
(6), kibarwa uhereye umunsi ukurikira uwo
ubutumwa bukurikiranywe bwashyikiririjwe icyo
kigo.
Icyiciro cya 9: Igenzura ry’imirimo y’iposita

articles.heading: Igenzura ry’imikorere y’Urwego rw’amaposita
Inshingano z’Urwego ngenzuramikorere ku byerekeye amaposita Urwego ngenzuramikorere rutegura kandi
articles.text:
rugashyira mu bikorwa amabwiriza akurikizwa kuri
serivisi z’amaposita:
1° gukurikirana itangwa rya serivisi
z’amaposita kuri bose, n’iterambere
ritunganye ry’urwego rw’amaposita ;
2° kugenzura uko ibigo by’amaposita
byemewe, byubahiriza inshingano zabyo;
3° gusesengura no gutanga impushya ku bifuza
gutanga serivisi z’imirimo y’amaposita;
4° kugena uburyo ibiciro bya serivisi
z’umwihariko ku kigo gitanga serivisi
z’amaposita kuri bose bishyirwaho;
5° kugenzura no gutanga bibaye ngombwa,
inama ku biciro bikurikizwa n’ibigo
by’amaposita byigenga;
6° rushingiye ku ibaruramutungo rirambuye
rikorwa n’ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe
ikwirakwizwa ry’imirimo y’iposita kuri
bose, kugena ingano y’ibigenda ku
nshingano z’iryo kwirakwizwa ry’imirimo
y’iposita ;
7° kugenzura uko ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe
ikwirakwizwa ry’imirimo y’iposita kuri
bose cyubahiriza amategeko agamije
gutuma abantu bashobora guhabwa serivisi,
aho baba bari hose kandi ku giciro
bashobora kwishyura, n’amategeko
yerekeye urwego rwa serivisi zitangwa uko
ateganywa mu masezerano y’imyaka
myinshi, yashyizweho umukono na Leta
hamwe n’ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe
ikwirakwizwa ry’imirimo y’iposita kuri
bose;
8° kugenzura ko ikigo cy’iposita gishinzwe
ikwirakwizwa ry’imirimo y’iposita kuri
bose gikoresha icyo yagenewe amafaranga
cyahawe n’ikigega cy’ikwirakwizwa
ry’imirimo y’iposita.
UMUTWE WA VI: AMAKOSA N’IBIHANO
BYO MU RWEGO RW’UBUTEGETSI
Icyiciro cya mbere: Amakosa n’ibihano bijyanye
n’itumanaho koranabuhanga

articles.heading: Gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga nta ruhushya Umuntu utangije, ukora cyangwa ufunguye
articles.text:
umuyoboro cyangwa serivisi z’itumanaho
koranabuhanga nta ruhushya rwemewe afite nk’uko
iri tegeko ribiteganya ahita ahagarikwa gutanga izo
serivisi kugeza igihe aherewe uruhushya nk’uko
biteganywa n’iri tegeko. Ahanishwa kandi ihazabu
yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga
y’u Rwanda miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000) na
miliyoni mirongo ine n’eshanu (45.000.000).

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’uruhushya nta burenganzira Uwahawe uruhushya uwo ari we wese, wihaye uburenganzira bwo guhererekanya uruhushya
articles.text:
rw’itumanaho koranabuhanga ku buryo
bunyuranyije n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000) na miliyoni
mirongo itanu (50.000.000). Uretse iyi hazabu yo
mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi, Urwego ngenzuramikorere
rushobora kumuhagarika gukora igihe kitarenze
amezi atatu (3) cyangwa kumwambura uruhushya.

articles.heading: Gukoresha uruhushya rutagifite agaciro Uwahawe uruhushya ukomeza gukoresha umuyoboro w’itumanaho koranabuhanga cyangwa
articles.text:
gutanga serivisi z’itumanaho koranabuhanga kandi
uruhushya rutarongerewe igihe nk’uko biteganywa
n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000) na miliyoni mirongo
ine n’eshanu (45.000.000).
Byongeye, igihe uwahawe uruhushya akomeje
gukoresha umuyoboro no gutanga serivisi kandi
yarahawe urwandiko rumwihanangiriza ahanishwa
ihazabu y’inyongera yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda y’ibihumbi
magana abiri (200.000) na miliyoni eshatu
(3.000.000) kuri buri munsi yakoze ubucuruzi bwe
atongeresheje uruhushya.

articles.heading: Kutamenyesha impinduka kuri nyir’umutungo Uwahawe uruhushya utamenyesheje impinduka zabaye kuri nyir’umutungo nk’uko biteganywa n’iri
articles.text:
tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati ya miliyoni eshanu
(5.000.000) na miliyoni mirongo itanu (50.000.000)
z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Kutubahiriza ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’icyemezo cyangwa amabwiriza y’Urwego ngenzuramikorere Iyo uwahawe uruhushya atubahirije icyemezo
articles.text:
cyihanangiriza cy’Urwego ngenzuramikorere
cyafashwe hakurikijwe ibiteganwa n’iri tegeko
ahanishwa kimwe cyangwa byinshi muri ibi bihano
bikurikira:
1° gutanga ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000) na
miliyoni cumi n’eshanu (15.000.000) kuri
buri munsi wose atubahirije ibyo asabwa,
uhereye igihe yamenyeshejwe icyemezo
cyongeye gushimangirwa;
2° gukora ibisabwa by’inyongera ku byerekeye
uruhushya rwe;
3° guhagarikirwa uruhushya mu gihe
gishobora kugenwa mu cyemezo
cy’ihagarika gitangwa n’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere;
4° kwamburwa uruhushya.

articles.heading: Ikumira mu gutanga serivisi Mu gihe uwahawe uruhushya akumiriye umuntu ku ihabwa rya serivisi ku buryo arengereye
articles.text:
ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko, Urwego ngenzuramikorere
rufata icyemezo cy’uko uwo wahawe uruhushya
akuraho iryo kumira. Utubahirije ibyo icyo cyemezo
kimusaba atanga ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
miliyoni ebyiri (2.000.000) na miliyoni icumi
(10.000.000) kuri buri munsi wose atubahirije ibyo
asabwa.

articles.heading: Kutubahiriza gahunda y’igenzura ry’urutonde rw’ibiciro Ufite ububasha bwizimbye ku isoko ry’itumanaho
articles.text:
utubahiriza gahunda y’igenzura ry’ibiciro nk’uko
biteganywa n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda iri
hagati ya miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000) na miliyoni
cumi n’eshanu (15.000.000) kuri buri munsi
atubahirije gahunda y’igenzura ry’urutonde
rw’ibiciro.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho n’ikoreshwa ry’ibikoresho byo mu itumanaho koranabuhanga nta ruhushya Umuntu wese ushyizeho cyangwa ukoresha
articles.text:
ibikoresho by’itumanaho koranabuhanga nta
ruhushya rwabigenewe, Urwego ngenzuramikorere
rumwambura ibyo bikoresho kandi hakiyongeraho
ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga
y’u Rwanda ari hagati y’ibihumbi magana atanu
(500.000) na miliyoni cumi n’eshanu (15.000.000).
Iyo Urwego ngenzuramikorere rubona ko
umutekano w’igihugu ubangamiwe ibyo bikoresho
abyamburwa burundu.

articles.heading: Ikoreshwa ry’impuzamirongo ya radiyo rinyuranyije n’amategeko Umuntu wese ukoresha igice icyo ari cyo cyose
articles.text:
cy’impuzamirongo ya radiyo anyuranyije
n’ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko, Urwego
ngenzuramikorere rumuha urwandiko rumuhagarika
gukoresha icyo gice cy’impuzamirongo ya radiyo,
kandi agacibwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi
magana atanu (500.000) na miliyoni eshanu
(5.000.000).
Mu gihe akomeje kwirengagiza kubahiriza
amategeko akoresha igice cy’impuzamirongo ya
radiyo binyuranyije n’amabwiriza y’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere, urwo rwego rushobora:
1° kumuhanisha ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000)
na miliyoni icumi (10.000.000) buri munsi
mu rwego rwo kubahiriza icyemezo
kimuhagarika;
2° gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba za tekiniki
zibuza umurongo gukoreshwa.

articles.heading: Gukomeza gukoresha uruhushya rwo gukoresha itumahaho rikoresha umurongo wa radiyo rwarangije igihe
articles.text:
Ukoresha uruhushya rw’itumanaho rikoresha
umurongo wa radio rwarangije igihe ahanishwa
ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga
y’u Rwanda miliyoni imwe (1.000.000).
Mu gihe uwahawe uruhushya akomeje gukora
binyuranyije n’icyemezo kimubuza cyatanzwe ku
buryo bukurikije iri tegeko, ahanishwa buri munsi
ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati
y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana atanu
(500.000) na miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000).

articles.heading: Kudatanga amakuru ku miyoboro ikodeshwa Umuntu wese udatanze amakuru yerekeranye n’imiyoboro ikodeshwa n’impinduka zabaye nk’uko
articles.text:
bisabwa n’iri tegeko, ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda miliyoni imwe (1.000.000) na miliyoni
eshanu (5.000.000).
Igihe ari ikigo gifite ububasha bwizimbye,
gihanishwa gutanga ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni
eshanu (5.000.000).

articles.heading: Kutamenyekanisha ibigenderwaho mu ihuzwa ry’imiyoboro y’itumanaho Ikigo gifite ububasha bwizimbye
articles.text:
kitamenyekanishije ibigenderwaho mu ihuzwa
ry’imiyoboro y’itumanaho nk’uko biteganywa n’iri
tegeko, gihanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000) na miliyoni icumi
(10.000.000), n’ihazabu y’inyongera ya miliyoni
imwe (1.000.000) buri munsi kitubahirije igihe
cyahawe mu ibaruwa icyihanangiriza kugira ngo
kibe cyatanze ibigenderwaho mu ihuzwa
ry’imiyoboro y’itumanaho.

articles.heading: Ibikoreshwa mu itumanaho bitubahirije amategeko Umuntu wese ukora, utumiza cyangwa ugerageza
articles.text:
gutumiza mu mahanga, gutanga, gucomeka,
kwemerera gucomeka ku muyoboro w’itumanaho
no gukoresha ibikoreshwa mu itumanaho bidahuje
n’amabwiriza abigenga mu rwego rwa tekiniki,
urw’ubuziranenge, rw’ibimenyetso bibiranga,
n’ibindi biteganywa n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu
yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga
y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana abiri (200.000) na
miliyoni imwe (1.000.000) kuri buri gikoresho.

articles.heading: Gutanga serivisi zo gushyira mu myanya ibikoresho by’itumanaho koranabuhanga no gukurikirana imikorere
articles.text:
yabyo nta cyemezo
Umuntu wese ukora adafite icyemezo kimwemerera
gutanga servisi zo gushyira mu myanya ibikoresho
by’itumanaho koranabuhanga no gukurikirana
imikorere yabyo nk’uko biteganywa n’iri tegeko
ahanishwa:
1° ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi
magana abiri (200.000) na miliyoni imwe
(1.000.000);
2° ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi
mirongo itanu (50.000) ku munsi igihe
cyose akomeje gukora nta cyemezo.

articles.heading: Guhererekanya icyemezo nta burenganzira Iyo uwahawe icyemezo kimwemerera gutanga serivizi zo gushyira mu myanya ibikoresho
articles.text:
by’itumanaho koranabuhanga no gukurikirana
imikorere yabyo agihererekanyije n’undi muntu ku
buryo bunyuranyije n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu
yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000).

articles.heading: Itumiza mu mahanga ribujijwe ry’ibikoresho byihariye by’itumanaho koranabuhanga Umuntu wese utumiza mu mahanga ibikoresho
articles.text:
by’itumanaho koranabuhanga byihariye adafite
uruhushya rudasanzwe ruteganywa n’iri tegeko
ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana
atanu (500.000) na miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000).

articles.heading: Kubuzwa gukora no kwamburwa uburenganzira bwo gukora Usibye ibihano ndetse n’ibyemezo by’igihe gito
articles.text:
cyangwa n’ubwishyu bw’ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi byavuzwe mu ngingo zibanziriza iyi,
igihe uwahawe uruhushya arenze cyangwa ananiwe
kubahiriza ku buryo bugaragara ingingo z’iri
tegeko, kandi ntashobore kwikosora mu gihe
kitarenze ukwezi kumwe uhereye igihe yasabwe
kubikora, Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushobora
kumwambura uruhushya cyangwa kumuhagarika
gutanga zimwe muri za serivisi asanzwe atanga.
Icyiciro cya 2: Amakosa n’ibihano ku bukungu
bushingiye ku itangazabumenyi

articles.heading: Gutanga serivisi z’iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi utabiherewe uruhushya Umuntu wese utanga serivisi z’iterambere
articles.text:
rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi atabiherewe
uruhushya nk’uko biteganywa n’iri tegeko
ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni imwe
(1.000.000) na miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000) kandi
agahagarikwa gukora.

articles.heading: Kutubahiriza icyemezo cyihanangiriza Iyo uwahawe uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi
articles.text:
atubahirije icyemezo kihanangiriza cy’Urwego
ngenzuramikorere cyafashwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda miliyoni imwe (1.000.000) na miliyoni
eshanu (5.000.000). Iyo atabyubahirije ahanishwa
ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga
y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000) ku
munsi uhereye igihe yahawe mu ibaruwa
imwihanangiriza kugira ngo abe yubahirije ibyo
asabwa.

articles.heading: Guhererekanya uruhushya nta burenganzira Iyo uwahawe uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi atanze
articles.text:
cyangwa atije uruhushya rwe nta burenganzira
bwanditse yahawe n’Urwego ngenzuramikorere
ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni imwe
(1.000.000) na miliyoni eshanu (5.000.000). Iyo
bibaye ngombwa urwo ruhushya rushobora
guhagarikwa.

articles.heading: Kwanga gutanga amakuru yerekeye utanga serivisi z’iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi Iyo uwahawe uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi
articles.text:
z’iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi
adatanze, yanze gutanga cyangwa atanze amakuru
ajyanye n’utanga serivisi za sosiyete
y’itangazabumenyi atuzuye cyangwa atari yo,
atayatanze mu buryo bwagenwe cyangwa mu gihe
cyateganyijwe, ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000) na miliyoni imwe
(1.000.000).

articles.heading: Kubangamira ubugenzuzi Iyo uwahawe uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’iterambere rishingiye ku itangazabumenyi
articles.text:
akerereje cyangwa abangamiye yabigambiriye
ubugenzuzi bw’Urwego ngenzuramikorere
ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana
abiri (200.000) na miliyoni imwe (1.000.000).

articles.heading: Gusaba uruhushya hakoreshejwe amakuru atari yo Iyo mu gihe cyo gusaba uruhushya uwarusabye yatanze amakuru azi neza ko atari yo, ahanishwa
articles.text:
ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati
y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi magana atanu
(500.000) na miliyoni imwe (1.000.000). Iyo bibaye
ngombwa Urwego ngenzuramikorere rumwambura
uruhushya yahawe hashingiwe ku makuru
y’ibinyoma.

articles.heading: Ibikoresho bitubahirije amategeko Umuntu wese ucuruza ibikoresho by’umukono koranabuhanga cyangwa utanga servisi z’icyemezo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga akoresheje ibikoresho bitemejwe
n’Urwego ngenzuramikorere ahanishwa ihazabu yo
mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
ari hagati ya miliyoni ebyiri (2.000.000) na miliyoni
eshanu (5.000.000). Iyo bibaye ngombwa Urwego
ngenzuramikorere rushobora guhagarika uruhushya
igihe cyose utanga serivisi z’icyemezo
koranabuhanga atujuje ibisabwa.

articles.heading: Kohereza ubutumwa bw’ubucuruzi butasabwe Umuntu wese utanga ubutumwa bw’ubucuruzi ku muguzi utaremeye ko yohererezwa ubwo butumwa,
articles.text:
ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi mirongo
itanu (50.000) ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000).

articles.heading: Kudatanga amakuru y’ibicuruzwa mu rwego koranabuhanga Iyo umuntu utanga ibintu cyangwa serivisi kugira
articles.text:
ngo bigurishwe, bikodeshwe cyangwa se
bihererekanywe hakoreshejwe ihererekanywa
koranabuhanga adashyira amakuru agenewe abaguzi
ku rubuga rwa interineti ari rwo runyuzwaho ibyo
bintu cyangwa serivisi ashaka gutanga nk’uko
biteganywa n’iri tegeko ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda ibihumbi mirongo itanu (50.000)
n’ibihumbi magana atanu (500.000) .

articles.heading: Kunyuranya n’ibiteganywa mu ruhushya Umuntu wese unyuranya n’ibiteganywa mu ruhushya yahawe bitavuzwe mu ngingo zibanziriza
articles.text:
iyi, ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi
magana atanu (500.000) na miliyoni eshanu
(5.000.000). Urwego ngenzuramikorere rushobora
guhagarika uruhushya rwe mu gihe kitarenze amezi
atatu (3) cyangwa kurumwambura burundu.

rw’ubutegetsi iri hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda
miliyoni imwe (1.000.000) na miliyoni eshanu
(5.000.000) kandi agahagarikwa gukora.

cyihanangiriza cy’Urwego ngenzuramikorere

ahanishwa ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi iri
hagati y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni imwe

kandi ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi ijana (100.000)
ku munsi uhereye itariki yahawe mu ibaruwa
imwihanangiriza kugira ngo abe yubahirije
ibisabwa.

rushobora guhagarikwa.

z’isakazamakuru adatanze, yanze gutanga cyangwa
